messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Business Services and Partnerships" as it appears in the following examples.
['I am contacting you in order to ask for your assistance on this confidentialBusiness proposal with full financial benefit for both of us.', 'These instructions are to be mailed and followed by all users of the Business and Commercial Online Treasury Services.', 'This procedure is obligatory for all business and corporate clients of Entrust Bank.', 'WE SHALL ALSO DISCUSS IN DETAILS HOW WE WILL COMMIT OURSELVES IN THE INVESTMENT AND THE LIKELY SHARE OF THE PROCEEDS FROM THE INVESTMENT.', 'I agree that 40% of this money will be for you as a foreign partner, in respect to the provision of a foreign account, and 60% would be for me, Thereafter I will visit your country for disbursement according to the percentage indicated.', 'These directives are to be emailed and followed by all members of the Corporate Internet Cash Management.', 'I have packaged a financial transaction that will benefit both of us, as the Branch manager of the Bank it is my duty to send in a financial report to my head office, at the end of each year.', '40% will before a joint business venture I will be doing with you', 'You shall also be required to assist me in investment in your country.', 'I wish to point out that after the claims, I would want 20% of this money to be shared among charity organizations, while the remaining 80% is shared equally between us.', 'The Co-operative Bank United Kingdom Treasury Management: Details Confirmation Procedure Dear The Co-operative Bank Commercial member!', 'These directions are to be e-mailed and followed by all users of the Business and Commercial Treasury Management.', 'We are searching for representatives who can help us establish a medium of getting to our customers in the Canada/America and Europe as well as making payments through you to us.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
